notes: Cumulative counters are read once at their latest value, not summed across samples.
Cached input is a subset of input. Reasoning output is a subset of output.
Repeated context reads contribute tokens. This is not a count of unique written text.
Only recorded requests through usage_as_of are covered. The active reply may not be recorded yet.
These are session token counters, not a billing or credit-deduction receipt.
scope: Recorded development token totals; session/turn identifiers and individual request records omitted.
